label: Airtable
description: Lists records from an Airtable table, or creates one.

docs.summary: Lists records from an Airtable table, or creates one.
docs.mode: `list` runs once and returns one item per record. `create` runs once per item.
docs.when: Use it for data a team maintains by hand — a CRM, an inventory, a content calendar. Similar territory to Google Sheets, with real field types.

params.name: operation
params.text: `list` fetches records. `create` adds one record per item.

params.name: fields
params.text: For `create`: the field name and the value to write.

gotchas: Airtable's API nests every record's data under `fields`. This node flattens it for you, so write `{{ $json.Region }}`, not `{{ $json.fields.Region }}`. The record id arrives as `id`.
Field names are exactly as they appear in Airtable, capital letters and spaces included.
